kind: agent-observed synthetic browser checks, not user-study evidence
method: Initial wide/light sequence used preview_act native select/click/type and actual Tab/Enter. Matrix repetition used DOM value/change/input events and button.click in preview_evaluate; not pointer-only or keyboard-only coverage.

keyboard.projectArrowDownEnter: did not commit selection; native select automation used

accessibility.initialTree: returned labeled comboboxes, textbox, checkboxes, regions, buttons and status
accessibility.reducedMotion: CSS source checked; no animation or transition in normal styles; preference not emulated

limitations: No real user or normal-host baseline
No host, daemon, indexing, inference or delivery tested
Source/API denylist is a limited regression check, not a security audit
